headline: Your sizing after losses is hurting performance.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Across 96 after‑loss trades you entered with a median size of ₹12,562, compared with a median of ₹6,578 on other trades, a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375 and had a win rate of 28%, while other trades posted a win rate of 39%. The overall cost of this behaviour was ₹1,05,732.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is something to keep an eye on.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size steady after a loss for the next window.
